checks.claim: 生平年表：1926普瓦捷生、1946高师、心理病理学文凭、1950入党1952退党、1951高师授课德里达听课、乌普萨拉/波兰/汉堡/克莱蒙-费朗、1961《疯癫史》博士论文（康吉莱姆保荐）、突尼斯、1968万塞讷、1970法兰西学院思想体系史讲席、GIP监狱信息小组、《规训与惩罚》1975、卷一1976、1978-79伊朗第一手报道与政治灵性、晚期古代课程、卷二卷三1984、1984-06-25卒、身后编订。
checks.locator: Life节（PCF 1950, left 1952; taught psychology at the ENS—Derrida was among his students; Uppsala 1955; Hamburg 1959; Clermont-Ferrand 1960; Vincennes 1968; Collège de France 1970; Iranian Revolution first-hand dispatches 1978–79; AIDS 1984）＋sep（History of Madness doctoral thesis sponsored by Canguilhem; 1972 revised edition; elected Collège de France as Professor of the History of Systems of Thought; died June 25, 1984; Vols II–III 1984）

checks.claim: 知识型与考古学、权力—知识、规训三手段与全景敞视、生命权力与治理术、压抑假说之驳、自身的关怀与生存美学、求真之志；著作年表与讲座系列编订本。
checks.locator: Major Works各小节（episteme; 'in knowing we control and in controlling we know'; panopticon; biopower; repressive hypothesis; care of the self）＋iep Genealogy/Governmentality/Ethics节

checks.claim: 康德批判之问倒转与人类学译注（2008身后出版）、萨特论战（19世纪的人/先验的自恋/普遍知识分子）、德里达1963批评与『从未完全愈合的决裂』及1972增订版回应、康吉莱姆保荐与正常病态区分、人之死与词与物论战、伊朗争议。
checks.locator: SEP Derrida节（in the early 1960s Derrida attended a seminar taught by Foucault; 'Cogito and the History of Madness'…criticizes Foucault's interpretation of Descartes; 'a rupture…which will never fully heal'）＋sep（inverts critical question 'what, in the apparently necessary, might be contingent'; 'transcendental narcissism'; universal intellectual; Kant's Anthropology 2008 posthumous）＋iep（philosophical antagonist; Iran dispatches）

checks.claim: 卒日IEP作6月26日（SEP作25日，从25并注两说）；1972年增订版回应德里达之细节、伊朗报道点名《晚邮报》与『政治灵性』措辞——本轮两百科读录未逐字覆盖。
